source_content.pdf_ref: Giải Thích Ngữ Pháp Tiếng Anh — Chương 12: Conditional Sentences — Type 1

starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ.
challenge.distractor_strategy: near_correct — sai ở chi tiết nhỏ

starter.stem: If global temperatures ___, sea levels will rise.
starter.explanation_short: If + Present Simple, will + V: If temperatures increase.
starter.explanation_long: Conditional Type 1: If + Present Simple, S + will + V.
starter.ielts_tip: Conditional Type 1: If + V, will + V. Không dùng will trong if-clause.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: will increase (will trong if-clause = sai)

starter.stem: If we reduce emissions, the environment ___ improve.
starter.explanation_long: Conditional Type 1: mệnh đề kết quả dùng will + V.
starter.ielts_tip: Conditional Type 1: kết quả dùng will.

starter.stem: If deforestation ___ stop, many species will become extinct.
starter.explanation_short: If + Present Simple (phủ định): doesn't stop.
starter.explanation_long: If + doesn't + V = Present Simple phủ định trong if-clause.
starter.ielts_tip: If-clause: Present Simple. Phủ định: don't/doesn't.

starter.stem: ___ governments invest in renewable energy, carbon emissions will decrease.
starter.explanation_short: If + Present, will + V = Conditional Type 1.
starter.explanation_long: If = điều kiện. When = chắc chắn xảy ra. Unless = if...not.
starter.feedback_wrong: If = điều kiện (có thể xảy ra).
starter.ielts_tip: If = possibility. When = certainty. Unless = if not.

starter.stem: ___ we take action, climate change will worsen.
starter.explanation_short: Unless = If...not: Unless we take action = If we don't take action.
starter.explanation_long: Unless = If we DON'T take action → climate change will worsen.
starter.ielts_tip: Unless = If not. Đừng dùng phủ định sau unless.

starter.stem: If people ___ more trees, air quality will improve.
starter.ielts_tip: Conditional Type 1: If + V, will + V.

starter.stem: If the pandemic continues, the economy ___ suffer greatly.
starter.explanation_long: Conditional Type 1: kết quả dùng will.
starter.feedback_wrong: will + V = kết quả Conditional Type 1.

starter.stem: If water pollution ___, marine life will be affected.
starter.feedback_wrong: If + V (chia theo ngôi), will + V.

starter.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'If governments will ban plastic bags, pollution will decrease.'
options: Sai: will ban → ban (bỏ will trong if-clause)
starter.correct_answer: Sai: will ban → ban (bỏ will trong if-clause)
starter.explanation_short: If + Present Simple: If governments ban (không will ban).
starter.explanation_long: Conditional Type 1: KHÔNG dùng will trong if-clause.
starter.feedback_wrong: If + V (no will). Will chỉ dùng trong mệnh đề kết quả.

starter.stem: If the world ___ to cooperate, we will solve climate change.

build_up.stem: If developing countries ___ in education, they will see significant economic growth.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: will invest (will trong if-clause nghe có vẻ đúng)

build_up.stem: ___ governments enforce stricter regulations, illegal deforestation will continue.
build_up.explanation_short: Unless = If not: Unless enforce = If don't enforce.
build_up.explanation_long: Unless + Present = If + don't + V. 'Unless governments enforce' = 'If governments don't enforce'.
build_up.ielts_tip: Unless = If not. Phủ định ẩn.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: If (cũng đúng nhưng cần thêm not)

build_up.stem: If the global population reaches 10 billion, food production ___ need to increase by 50%.
build_up.explanation_long: Conditional Type 1: If + Present, will + V.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: would (Type 2, nhưng đây là possible → Type 1)

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'If the economy will recover, unemployment rates will drop significantly.'
options: Sai: will recover → recovers (bỏ will trong if-clause)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: will recover → recovers (bỏ will trong if-clause)
build_up.explanation_long: Conditional Type 1: KHÔNG dùng will trong if-clause.
build_up.ielts_tip: If + V (Present), will + V. No will in if-clause.

build_up.stem: If access to clean water ___, millions of lives will be saved.
Phát hiện lỗi: 'If the temperature rises by 2 degrees, coastal cities would be flooded.'
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: would → will (Type 1 dùng will, không would)
build_up.explanation_short: If + Present (rises) → will (không would). Type 1 = real/possible.
build_up.explanation_long: If + Present → will. 'Would' dùng trong Type 2 (unreal/unlikely).
build_up.feedback_wrong: If + Present → will. If + Past → would.

build_up.stem: If we ___ waste properly, landfills will overflow.
build_up.explanation_long: If + Present Simple phủ định: don't + V.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'If we reduced carbon emissions now, the planet will be safer.'
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: reduced → reduce (Type 1 cần Present, không Past)
build_up.explanation_short: If + Present (reduce), will + V. 'Reduced' = Past → Type 2.
build_up.explanation_long: 'Will' = Type 1 → if-clause cần Present: reduce (không reduced).
build_up.feedback_wrong: If + Present, will + V. Không trộn Past + will.
build_up.ielts_tip: If + V (Present) + will = Type 1. If + V (Past) + would = Type 2.

build_up.stem: If countries ___ together on environmental issues, global warming can be controlled.
___ immediate action is taken, the consequences of climate change will be irreversible.
build_up.explanation_short: Unless = If not: Unless action is taken = If action is NOT taken.
build_up.explanation_long: Unless + Present, will + V. 'Unless action is taken' = 'If action is not taken'.
build_up.ielts_tip: Unless + V, will + V. Ngữ cảnh negative.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'If the government will implement stricter environmental laws, industries will be forced to reduce their carbon footprint.'
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'If + will implement' → 'If + implements' (no will in if-clause). Lớp 2: 'will be forced' = đúng (mệnh đề kết quả).
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (will be forced) đúng

options: If governments invested more in education
If governments invest more in education
If governments will invest more in education
If governments invest more in education
challenge.correct_answer: If governments invest more in education, the economy will benefit greatly.
challenge.explanation_short: If + Present (invest), will + benefit = Type 1 chuẩn.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: If + invest (Present) + will benefit = Type 1 chuẩn. Lớp 2: Option A trộn Past (invested) + will = sai. Lớp 3: Option C dùng will trong if-clause. Lớp 4: Option D trộn thì.
challenge.ielts_tip: Task 2: If + V, will + V = Conditional Type 1.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A trộn Type 2 form + will

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Unless developing countries don't receive financial aid, they will struggle to combat poverty and inequality.'
challenge.explanation_short: Unless = If not → đã có phủ định. 'Unless don't' = phủ định kép.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Unless don't receive' = double negative. Unless = If not → đã phủ định. 'Unless + don't' = 'If not not' = khẳng định → sai nghĩa. Đúng: 'Unless countries receive' hoặc 'If countries don't receive'.
challenge.feedback_wrong: Unless = If not. Không thêm not/don't sau unless.
challenge.ielts_tip: Unless + V (khẳng định). KHÔNG unless + don't.

challenge.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT cho IELTS Writing:
options: If the world does not address climate change
future generations will suffer the consequences.
If the world will not address climate change
If the world did not address climate change
challenge.correct_answer: If the world does not address climate change, future generations will suffer the consequences.
challenge.explanation_short: If + does not (Present), will + V = Type 1 chuẩn.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'does not address' (Present phủ định) + 'will suffer' = Type 1 chuẩn. Lớp 2: Option B dùng will trong if-clause. Lớp 3: Option C trộn Past + will. Lớp 4: Option D trộn Present + would.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 If + does not + V, will + V = chuẩn!
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D trộn Type 1 + Type 2

challenge.stem:
Câu nào ĐÚNG HOÀN TOÀN?
'If poverty ___ [A], social stability ___ [B] and crime rates ___ [C].'
options: [A] will increase / [B] will decrease / [C] will rise
challenge.explanation_short: If + Present, will + V and will + V. Tất cả mệnh đề kết quả dùng will.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A] increases = Present (if-clause). Lớp 2: [B] will decrease + [C] will rise = kết quả. Lớp 3: Option B thiếu will ở [C]. Option C dùng will ở [A].
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 If + increases, will decrease and will rise!
challenge.feedback_wrong: If + V, will V and will V.
challenge.ielts_tip: Nhiều kết quả: If + V, will V and will V.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B thiếu will ở [C]

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'If international organizations will provide more funding for education, and if governments will support these initiatives, many children will benefit.'
options: will provide more funding for education
these initiatives many children will benefit
challenge.correct_answer: will provide more funding for education
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'If + will provide' → 'If + provide'. Lớp 2: 'if + will support' cũng sai → 'if + support'. Cả B và C sai, B trước.
challenge.feedback_wrong: If + V (Present), not if + will + V.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (if + will support) cũng sai

challenge.stem: Chọn câu body paragraph Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: Education will decrease social inequality if it will be improved.
challenge.correct_answer: If education is improved, social inequality will decrease, and economic growth will accelerate.
challenge.explanation_short: If + is improved (Present Passive), will + V = chuẩn.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'is improved' = Present Simple Passive trong if-clause → đúng. Lớp 2: 'will decrease' + 'will accelerate' = parallel result clauses. Lớp 3: Option B dùng will trong if-clause. Option C dùng Past (Type 2 form + will).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 If + Present Passive, will + V = academic chuẩn!
challenge.ielts_tip: Task 2: If + is/are + V3 (passive in if-clause) OK.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C trộn Past + will

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'If renewable energy becomes more affordable, consumers will adopt it, and fossil fuel companies would face significant losses.'
options: and fossil fuel companies would face significant losses
challenge.correct_answer: and fossil fuel companies would face significant losses
challenge.explanation_short: Type 1: will (không would). Trộn will + would = sai.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'becomes' = Present (if-clause đúng). Lớp 2: 'will adopt' = Type 1 result (đúng). Lớp 3: 'would face' = Type 2 → trộn với Type 1 = inconsistent.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 Type 1: will adopt + will face. Không trộn would!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Type 1: tất cả kết quả dùng will, không trộn would.
challenge.ielts_tip: If + Present, will + V. Nhất quán will cho mọi kết quả.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B/C trông có vẻ sai nhưng đúng

challenge.correct_answer: Unless pollution is reduced, health problems will increase significantly.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Unless pollution is reduced' = Unless + Present Passive → OK. Lớp 2: Option A 'Unless don't' = double negative. Option C 'Unless will' = sai. Option D trộn would.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 Unless + is reduced, will increase = chuẩn!
challenge.ielts_tip: Unless + Present, will + V. No double negative.

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'If global leaders [A] will cooperate on climate policy, emissions [B] would decrease, and unless nations [C] don't act now, the consequences will be severe.'
challenge.explanation_short: [A] will cooperate → cooperate. [B] would → will. [C] unless don't → unless + V (no don't).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A] 'will cooperate' → 'cooperate' (no will in if-clause). Lớp 2: [B] 'would' → 'will' (Type 1 dùng will). Lớp 3: [C] 'unless don't act' → 'unless act' (unless = if not, double negative).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] cooperate | [B] will decrease | [C] unless nations act!
challenge.feedback_wrong: [A] no will in if. [B] Type 1: will. [C] unless = if not, no don't.
challenge.ielts_tip: If + V (no will), will + V. Unless + V (no not).
